name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Safer and faster sync. Titles a friend no longer lists are removed only after two syncs in a row, and a large removal (more than 25 titles and 10% of a library) waits until you confirm it on the Libraries tab. Friends tell each other when their library changes, so new titles arrive within minutes. Failed requests are retried and interrupted downloads resume. Unchanged syncs are much faster on large libraries, friends are checked in parallel, and episode images are downloaded at a smaller size. Update both servers.
